title: The First Puritan Christmas Tree · story excerpt
instructions: 真人历史作品朗读，非现代场景对话或官方试卷。先独立听音并完成6题，再提交核对；录制署名不出题。级别只是编写目标，未做真实考生难度标定。来源与署名可在开始后查看；若打开外部全文或原音，后续继续按已见材料记录。
transcript:
Mrs. Olcott called her boys, and bade them go to the pine woods and get the finest, handsomest young hemlock tree that they could find.
"Get one that is straight and tall, with well-boughed branches on it, and put it where you can draw it under the wood-shed after dark," she added.
The boys went to Pine Hill, and there they picked out the finest young tree on all the hill, and said, "We will take this one." So, with their hatchets they hewed it down and brought it safely home the next night when all was dark. And when Roger was quietly sleeping in the adjoining room, they dragged the tree into the kitchen. It was too tall, so they took it out again and cut it off two or three feet at the base. Then they propped it up, and the curtains being down over the windows, and blankets being fastened over the curtains to prevent any one looking in, and the door being doubly barred to prevent any one coming in, they all went to bed.
Very early the next morning, while the stars shone on the snow-covered hills—the same stars that shone sixteen hundred years before on the hills when Christ was born in Bethlehem—the little Puritan mother in New England arose very softly. She went out and lit the kitchen fire anew from the ash-covered embers. She fastened upon the twigs of the tree the gifts she had bought in Boston for her boys and girl. Then she took as many as twenty pieces of candle and fixed them upon the branches. After that she softly called Rupert, Robert and Lucy, and told them to get up and come into the kitchen.

questions.prompt: What kind of tree did Mrs. Olcott request? Write ONE WORD.
questions.evidence: get the finest, handsomest young hemlock tree that they could find.
questions.explanation: 所要树种是 hemlock；pine woods 是寻找地点。

questions.prompt: Why did the boys cut the base of the tree again?
options: Its branches were too wide for the path.
The tree was too tall for the room.
answers: The tree was too tall for the room.
questions.evidence: It was too tall, so they took it out again and cut it off two or three feet at the base.
questions.explanation: too tall 是二次锯短的原因，不是枝条宽或树干坏。

questions.prompt: Why were blankets placed over the curtains?
options: To help the children sleep outside
To keep falling snow off the tree
questions.evidence: blankets being fastened over the curtains to prevent any one looking in
questions.explanation: prevent ... looking in 明确是遮挡视线。

questions.prompt: What shows how early the mother got up?
options: All the children were already playing.
questions.evidence: Very early the next morning, while the stars shone on the snow-covered hills
questions.explanation: 星星仍可见，说明起床时间很早；儿童是后来被叫醒。

questions.prompt: Where had she bought the gifts? Write ONE WORD.
questions.evidence: the gifts she had bought in Boston for her boys and girl.
questions.explanation: Boston 是购礼物的城市，不是故事开头找树的 Pine Hill。

questions.prompt: Where did the mother fix the pieces of candle?
questions.evidence: Then she took as many as twenty pieces of candle and fixed them upon the branches.
questions.explanation: candles 固定在树枝；这是历史故事的描述，不是现代操作指南。
